Synopsis:
Norway's King Harald V died at age 89 at Oslo University Hospital following a bacterial infection. His son Crown Prince Haakon (53) ascends to the throne as Norway's fourth king since 1905. The death occurs amid significant turmoil for the Norwegian royal family: Crown Princess Mette-Marit faces scrutiny over Jeffrey Epstein ties, her son Marius was convicted of rape and sentenced to four years, and public support for the monarchy has declined from 70% to ~64%. Harald's 35-year reign was marked by modernization, public accessibility, and strong personal popularity.
